title: Bees in the City
text:
This month, a magazine article talks about bees in our city. Bees help plants grow because they carry pollen from one flower to another. Many people in the city now keep small gardens with flowers for bees. The writer says that bees are becoming rare in many places.

The article also includes a short interview with a beekeeper named Ana. She says that she has three hives on her roof. Ana sells honey at the market every Saturday. She hopes more people will plant flowers next spring.

questions.text: What do bees do, according to paragraph one?
options: They carry pollen from one flower to another
They live only in the desert

questions.text: Where does Ana keep her hives?
options: In a garden next to the school

questions.text: Why does the writer probably want people to plant flowers?
options: Because bees need flowers to live
Because the market needs more space
Because bees are becoming too big

questions.text: What can we infer about Ana?
options: She cares about bees and wants to help them

vocabulary.definition: a fine powder from flowers that helps plants make seeds
the colorful parts of a plant that often have a pleasant smell
a sweet, thick food made by bees

paragraph_translations: Neste mês, um artigo de revista fala sobre abelhas na nossa cidade. As abelhas ajudam as plantas a crescer porque levam pólen de uma flor para outra. Muitas pessoas da cidade agora têm pequenos jardins com flores para as abelhas. A escritora diz que as abelhas estão ficando raras em muitos lugares.

O artigo também inclui uma breve entrevista com uma apicultora chamada Ana. Ela diz que tem três colmeias no telhado de casa. Ana vende mel no mercado todos os sábados. Ela espera que mais pessoas plantem flores na próxima primavera.
